Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us. We have come to the end of a one-sided affair. And since Sri Lanka chased the target down in less than 40 overs, they have got a bonus point. The Islanders next face the men from the Caribbean on 16th November at 1300 IST in Harare. We hope you join us for it. Till then, cheers!
Sri Lanka captain UPUL THARANGA credits everyone for playing so well. Feels the bowler did a great job and they stuck to their plans. Says the plan was to bowl the right lengths.
Man of the Match, DHANANJAYA DE SILVA says the ball was moving around in the first 5-6 overs. Adds he enjoyed batting with Kusal Perera and Niroshan Dickwella.

Zimbabwe captain GRAEME CREMER feels after losing the toss it was tough to bat on. Admits it was not a 150 wicket and they should have taken the total at least till 220. Hopes they will come back hard in the second game. Feels the catching was the positive today.

The odds were always against Zimbabwe. They needed a miracle to pull something off here. With not much to defend, the Rhodesian bowlers were dealt with a bad hand. They tried hard and did their best, but it was always going to be difficult. Earlier in the day, a brilliant collective performance from the Sri Lankan bowling department restricted the Zimbabweans to a paltry score.

Sri Lanka have won this match comfortably. It was expected, really. With only a target of 155 to chase down, and with the quality of the batsmen in their ranks, you would have always tipped the Islanders to clinch it. Dhananjaya de Silva was the man who led the charge. He started things off with Kusal Perera with a 56-run stand and then, when Dickwella came into bat, the pair just kept on going. Niroshan just missed out on a fifty while de Silva remained unbeaten on 78. An 84-run partnership was stitched between these two.
THAT IS IT! Fullish on middle and off, Mendis drags it through the mid-wicket region for a couple. SRI LANKA WIN BY 8 WICKETS AND TAKE THE BONUS POINT AS WELL!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Slower one around off, de Silva defends it away off his back foot.
SIX! Poor ball, punished! Short ball on middle and leg, Mendis pounces on it and pulls it hard over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Nicely flighted ball on off, Mendis drives it towards mid off.
Tossed up ball on off, Kusal gets onto his front foot and defends.
Around middle, Mendis pushes it towards covers.
Driven through mid off by de Silva for a single.
Tad short on off, turning away, de Silva goes onto his back foot and cuts it towards point.
Good reply by the bowler, short of a length ball, Mendis lets it go through.
FOUR! Take that! Fuller length ball on middle, Mendis smacks it hard down the ground. The mid on fielder puts in a dive to his left but the ball goes through and crosses the fence.
Good length ball on off, Mendis gets onto his front foot and pushes it to mid on.
Full ball on off, slower one, de Silva digs it out through mid on for a single.
KUSAL MENDIS is the next batsman in.

OUT! Dickwella throws it away! Short of a length ball, Dickwella comes down the track and looks to go big but mistimes it completely. He gets a top edge and the ball flies high up in the air. Mumba runs forward from third man and takes a good catch. Sri Lanka lose their second, need 15 more runs to win. Dickwella misses out on his fifty.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven towards cover-point. There is a fielder.
Landed around off, de Silva defends it off his back foot.
Landed outside off, de Silva taps it towards point.
Fullish ball around off, de Silva gets onto his front foot and defends.
Dickwella comes down the track and takes it on the full, pushes it to long on for a single.
Shortish ball, de Silva flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish on the pads, Dickwella flicks it through square leg for a single.
Angles in a length ball from outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva stays right behind the line of the delivery and meets it with a straight blade.
Length ball just around off, it's defended off the front foot.
It's raining boundaries here. De Silva this time walks across to this fuller ball and lofts it across the line. Gets it across the mid-wicket region for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! He's muscled that! Length ball around off, Dhananjaya de Silva stands firm and pulls it hard over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Solid from Dhananjaya. He stands his ground and blocks it out.
Fuller ball outside off, de Silva lofts this over wide mid on and picks up a couple of runs for it.
TINASHE PANYANGARA is back on to bowl.
Dhananjaya de Silva eases this loopy ball from Graeme Cremer down to long on for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Flatter and on the stumps, it's kept out from within the crease and hit back in the direction of the bowler.
Loopy and on a length, turning in a bit on the body, it goes off the pads and falls on the leg side.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Short, flat and turning in on middle and leg, it's pulled through backward square leg for a single.
Pitched just back of a driving length around off, the southpaw skips down the track and pushes it back down the ground for a single to end the over.
FOUR! Excellent placement. Full on middle and leg, Dickwella gets low to this one and sweeps it through backward square leg to send it all the way.
Steps out to this one and slaps it through mid-wicket for two runs.
FOUR! Makes good use of his crease here. Goes deep in it and pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Short and flat on the stumps, it's pulled away to the leg side for a single.
Looped up delivery from Raza, it's kept out off the front foot and into the track.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side.
Comes down the track and fails to reach the pitch perfectly. Ends up padding it away.
de Silva waits for the ball to come to him and then ultimately steers it to deep point for another run.
Rocks back and crunches it through the cover region for one run.
Dickwella steps out to this one but doesn't get to the pitch of the ball, pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball around off, turning away, Dhananjaya stays back and punches it to deep cover for a run.
DRINKS BREAK!
The left-hander presses forward to this fullish delivery and blocks it out.
Floated delivery around off, it's pushed to the cover region.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Outside off, on a shorter length as well, Niroshan Dickwella looks to cut but the ball keeps a little low.

FOUR! Back of a length outside off, Dickwella plays this very late and cuts it down towards third man. Beats the chasing fielder and that will be a boundary. The 50-run stand comes up with it as well.
It's worked to the on side for a single.
Outside off, Niroshan gets an outside edge as he tries to play this. It goes towards short third man where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Coming in on middle and leg, it's worked through mid-wicket for one.
Dhananjaya prods forward to this flighted ball and keeps it out off his front foot.
FOUR! Short, flat and outside off, de Silva backs away and cuts it through point. Beats the two men inside the circle and gets a boundary to his name.

Great effort out in the deep! Cremer loops it around off, Dickwella gets low to this one and reverse sweeps it towards third man. It seems the ball will race away to the fence but Panyangara chases the ball and dives to keep it just inside the ropes. Save a vital run for his side as he keeps the batsmen down to three.
GRAEME CREMER is on to bowl now.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Loopy and fuller on the stumps, it's eased down to long on for another single.
It's worked through the mid-wicket region for an easy single.
FOUR! That's a great shot! Dickwella makes great use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Floats this one up once more but this time it's on middle and off, de Silva works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Starts from around the wicket and floats it up around off, de Silva leans ahead and wrists it down towards mid on.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full outside off, Niroshan drives it hard towards covers. Cremer is the man at short cover and he makes a brilliant, reflex dive to stop the ball from going to the fence. Great effort!
Back of a length going down, the ball brushes Dickwella's shirt as he misses the pull shot.
FOUR! Shot. Fuller outside off, Dickwella leans into the shot and drives it through the covers. Didn't try to hit that too hard and timed it well. Lovely.
Doesn't exactly get a hold of it but it's enough to clear the infield. Gets it over the mid-wicket region and gets two runs for it.
Fuller on the stumps, de Silva clips it through mid-wicket for one.
2nd ODI fifty for Dhananjaya de Silva!
Length ball outside off, Dhananjaya runs it down to third man and gets a single for it. Brings up his fifty with that and he's done it in quick time.
Full on the stumps, it's driven to mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! He's got a real hold of it. Short of a length delivery and this is pulled away hard. Hit over square leg and sent across the fence for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery angling in to the body, Dhananjaya works it through mid-wicket and takes two more.

DROPPED! But that was hit very, very hard. Back of a length delivery on off, de Silva dances down the wicket and hammers this back to the bowler. Chibhabha sticks his hands out to his left in an attempt to take it but is unable to keep a hold of it. It goes towards the cover region as the batsmen take two.
Full and fired at the base of off stump, it's bunted back to the bowler to end the over.
Pitches this just ahead of a length and it's around off, it's worked towards mid-wicket. Niroshan wants the single but won't get it.
Back of a length coming in to the body, it's tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Extremely tight line from Carl Mumba, he bowls a short of a length on off stump, Dhananjaya stays behind the line and plays it back in the direction of the bowler.

FOUR! Pierces the gap beautifully! Dhananjaya de Silva is just enjoying himself here. Back of a length delivery wide outside off, he hangs back and crunches it through the cover region. Beats the chasing fielder as the ball reaches the fence first.
Fuller length delivery just outside off, Niroshan Dickwella works this off the inside half to the leg side and scampers to the other end to complete a single.
CARL MUMBA comes into the bowling attack.

FOUR! Too straight and that's been put away. Fuller on the pads, de Silva just picks it off his pads and flicks it aerially through the square leg region for a boundary. A wicket and 9 runs have come off this over.
Fullish in length and pitched outside off, the left-hander runs it down to third man off the outer half of the bat. A single is taken.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fires it full and way outside off, Dickwella takes a step across and drives it firmly through the gap in the covers. Sends it all the way to the boundary as the timing was perfect.
Back of a length delivery angled across, Dickwella stays back and punches it in front of covers.
NIROSHAN DICKWELLA is in at No.3.

OUT! OUTSTANDING CATCH! Short of a length ball on middle and off, Perera goes for the pull shot. Raza goes towards his left near deep square leg and takes a stunning catch. That's a huge wicket for Zimbabwe. But Sri Lanka need less than 100 runs now.
Length ball on middle and off, Perera defends it from within his crease.
CHAMU CHIBHABHA into the attack.

Fuller length ball outside off, de Silva drives it towards the mid off region.
Around off, de Silva steps out and flicks it to the leg side.
Short of a length ball on off, de Silva pulls it over mid-wicket. The fielder runs behind the ball and does well to stop it. The batsmen pick up three runs.
Good length ball on off, de Silva pushes it towards mid on.
On the pads, worked away through square leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, de Silva pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller length ball around off, Perera drives it down the ground for a single.

Landed around off, Perera taps it to the off side.

FOUR! Poor ball! Short and down the leg, de Silva helps the ball on its way with a pull shot. The ball crosses the long leg fence for a four. 50 up for Sri Lanka!
Landed outside off, Perera pushes it towards point.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short of a length ball on off, Perera pulls it through wide mid on for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Perera mistimes it this time to the off side.
FOUR! Short of a length ball on the pads, Perera pulls it away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
de Silva comes down the track and whips it through mid on for a single.
Good length ball outside off, de Silva punches it away off his back foot.
Fullish on the pads, de Silva tries to flick but misses. The ball goes to the on side off the pads and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Fuller length ball around off, Perera tries to drive but gets an outside edge which goes to third man. Single taken.
Length ball on middle and off, Perera flicks it to the mid-wicket region.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off now, Perera drives it hard through the cover region for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, punched straight to the cover fielder.

Flicked away through the leg side for a single.

Good length ball outside off, de Silva punches it away to the off side, didn't time it that well though.
Fuller length ball outside off, de Silva drives it towards wide of mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller length ball outside off, Perera drives it to covers.
Back of a length ball on off, Perera stays back in his crease and defends.

Banged in short on off, de Silva lets it go over him.

FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Fuller length ball outside off, de Silva drives it down the ground. Beats mid off and runs past the fence.

Full and on the pads, worked away to fine leg for a single to get off the mark.

Big appeal for a caught behind but it's a NO BALL! Landed outside off, de Silva looks to play but gets beaten probably. The fielders appeal but the umpire signals a no ball for overstepping. Was there an edge? There was some noise though. Free Hit coming up.
We are back for the chase. KUSAL PERERA and DHANANJAYA DE SILVA are the Sri Lankan openers. TINASHE PANYANGARA to bowl first up. Here we go!
